properties.name: Yard limit
properties.note: The deck and the flattened land north of it to Albone, east and south of Mill Creek (under Exposition Boulevard, the curved culvert from the roundabout to Millvale Boulevard, and Millvale Boulevard), west of the CUT structures and the APEx viaduct. The CUT platform deck and its throats are embanked (Ben, 26 October), so nothing runs under them.
